name: Endless Atlas
oracle_text: {2}, {T}: Draw a card. Activate only if you control three or more lands with the same name.
blocked_sentences: {2}, {T}: Draw a card. Activate only if you control three or more lands with the same name

needs.what: a value giving the size of the largest group of objects matching a selector that share one name (e.g. {"max_same_name_count": {"controller": "you", "types": ["Land"], "zone": "battlefield"}}), usable in an activated ability's activation condition as a cmp >= 3
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `count` totals every match regardless of name; `max_count_of` groups per player, not per name; `shares_a_name_with` needs an already-bound object, and nothing iterates the lands as candidates inside a condition. An `any` of literal `name` counts for the basic land names would miss snow basics, nonbasic duplicates and copied/renamed lands, so it would be an approximation
